title: Site map canvas: React Flow attribution link
context: React Flow renders a small 'React Flow' link on the canvas by default. It is NOT a license condition: the library is MIT and their docs confirm removal via proOptions hideAttribution is permitted; the team asks removers to consider supporting them (Pro is 169 USD/month, not required). Categorically different from tldraw's contractual watermark. The dashboard is paqad's client-facing product surface (ASICS rollout: never third-party branding in client material).

options.label: Hide the link and sponsor xyflow

rationale: Owner locked via tray 2026-08-18: hide via proOptions.hideAttribution (MIT-legal per xyflow docs); dashboard is paqad's client-facing surface and third-party branding is out for the ASICS rollout. Revisit sponsorship if the map becomes core to paid paqad.
